name: Web Paint
prompt: Create a web application like paint running in the browser. It muste be usable on smartphone and tablet with touchscreen. you can choose color, pen style and thickness. you are able to save your drawing.
teamDirectionSamples: add some shapes like stars or circle

name: Flappy Pigeon
prompt: Build a Flappy Bird-style game in browser based language. Implement gravity, pipes, jumping, scoring, and collision detection. Keep it simple but playable on ipad tablet with small screen and touch screen on a smartphone. polish the Flappy Bird style game: add background images, custom bird and pipe images, sound effects for jump/collision/scoring, smoother animations. Also list the required assets.
teamDirectionSamples: Add parallax scrolling for the background to make the game feel more dynamic
Create animated sprites for the bird flapping wings during jump and fall

name: Snake
prompt: Create a snake-style game. Add levels with different layouts, power-ups (speed boost, invincibility), leaderboard, and smooth animations to the game. Include explosion animations and game over screen. Keep it simple but playable on ipad tablet with small screen and touch screen on a smartphone.

name: Wordle
prompt: Create a daily word guessing game where players have 6 attempts to guess a 5-letter word. Include a touch-friendly keyboard, color-coded feedback tiles (green, yellow, gray), and statistics tracking. Optimize for iPad display and touch interaction. Stay simple
teamDirectionSamples: create a fancy ui and animated background

name: Solitaire
prompt: Create a playable Klondike solitaire card game in a single index.html file with embedded CSS and JavaScript. Make it responsive for iPad and mobile with touch-enabled drag-and-drop. Include 7 tableau piles, 4 foundation piles, stock and waste piles. Use standard solitaire rules and simple card visuals.
teamDirectionSamples: las vegas casino stylized HUD design
add sound effects reflecting cards slaping

name: Sudoku
prompt: Create an iPad-optimized Sudoku web app featuring a touch-friendly 9x9 grid, comfortable number input pad, multiple difficulty levels, and smart hints. Include pencil marks, auto-save, and progress tracking in a clean interface that works seamlessly. Keep it simple but playable on ipad tablet with small screen and touch screen on a smartphone.

name: Space Invaders
prompt: Build a classic Space Invaders game with rows of descending aliens, player spaceship with left/right movement and shooting, shields that degrade when hit, increasing difficulty per wave, score system, and retro pixel art style. Include explosion animations and game over screen. Keep it simple but playable on ipad tablet with small screen and touch screen on a smartphone.

name: Tetris
prompt: Build a classic Tetris game with the seven standard tetrominoes (I, O, T, S, Z, J, L), a 10-column by 20-row playfield, gravity that speeds up as levels progress, line clearing with multi-line bonuses (single, double, triple, tetris), next-piece preview, hold-piece slot, score and level display, and a game over screen when the stack reaches the top. Keep controls touch-friendly: tap to rotate, swipe left/right to move, swipe down for soft drop, two-finger tap for hard drop. Include subtle line-clear animations and a clean retro-blocky visual style. Single self-contained index.html, playable on ipad tablet and smartphone.
teamDirectionSamples: Classic Game Boy color palette with green-tinted background
Smooth piece-locking animation with screen shake on tetris clears
Add a ghost piece showing where the active tetromino will land
